title: Certify native frame operations for the P104 two-target correction
head: 32c01e0f064150f39ec36bf8edc75527456171fb
body:
PR2445 explicitly leaves the native transport realization of its two-target P104 correction open. This source-pinned package supplies all 236 added transport occurrences through 161 distinct Gaussian monomial/positive-child/monomial recipes. Every added edge and its inverse is checked independently for signed Pauli action and exact global phase. The existing 78-helper construction and minimum remain credited to Ross Richardson/PR2445.

A complete 4,734-event forward framed induction checks all 358 independent logical inputs, 128,164 endpoint coefficients, 208 intrinsic endpoint adapters and 14,400 physical root pairings. All 150 dirty helper logical values restore. The native invoice remains 702 added rank units and 3,070 overall; all eight inherited owned private lifetimes are preserved under their original contract.

Validation: registered standard-library Python 3.12 replay, eight semantic faults, equivalent-basis positive control, unchanged Git-free source export, fail-before-import source mutation, missing-evidence refusal, complete decompressed forward/inverse recipe regeneration, metadata/source pins and whitespace checks all pass. A separate AI agent inspected the native/source/scope proof and independently reran the optimized verifier on native CPython 3.12.7 with no actionable finding. Hosted CI is reported separately.

This establishes finite native frame realization. It does not provide bit/tape scalar lowering, the supplier reverse orientation, global owners, precision/all-size admission, a favorable full moment, a complete104-target correction or new kappa. Inverse edge recipes alone do not establish reverse supplier admission. Native boundary rank is not automatically recursive excess cost.

Scientific base: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2` (priority revision4). Exact PR2445 source: `6def43ad673b91dbd491389964d1dcd059bf2ac2`. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2445#issuecomment-6190471533). Exact blobs, SHA256 pins, proof, checker and open next questions are included. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; predecessor source and license credits retained. No independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
